native_mechanisms: Stone on a corner: a node's distance is finalized once and never reconsidered (settled/visited set).
A duck carries a spooled thread: each reached node holds a running tentative sum of road weights along the path to it.

Each round, walk the flock and find the leader duck — the shortest carried thread among unstoned nodes — and settle it before any other duck moves (linear argmin over the live frontier, no priority structure).
core_technique: Dijkstra over a compacted live frontier whose minimum is found by an AVX2-vectorized linear argmin scan (with index recovery pass), plus a permanent-settled flag array, CSR edge build, out-degree-zero pruning, and a 4-ary lazy-deletion heap fallback once the frontier exceeds a density-tuned threshold — i.e. the well-known array-scan Dijkstra variant with SIMD, backed by heap Dijkstra.
